name: scientific-figure-library
description: Local image-code knowledge library with native macOS and local Web clients, plus MCP and Skill interfaces for external tools.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config vite.local.config.ts && node scripts/esbuild-server.mjs
scripts.package:npm: node scripts/release-preflight.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/package-npm.mjs
scripts.package:wisp: node scripts/release-preflight.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/package-wisp.mjs
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run test:smoke
scripts.package:codex: node scripts/release-preflight.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/package-codex.mjs
scripts.package:claude: node scripts/release-preflight.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/package-claude.mjs
scripts.package:cursor: node scripts/release-preflight.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/package-cursor.mjs
scripts.package:windows: npm run build && node scripts/package-local-client.mjs windows-x64
scripts.package:macos: npm run build && node scripts/package-local-client.mjs macos-native
scripts.package:macos:arm64: npm run build && node scripts/package-local-client.mjs macos-arm64
scripts.package:macos:x64: npm run build && node scripts/package-local-client.mjs macos-x64
scripts.package:windows:no-node: npm run build && node scripts/package-local-client.mjs windows-x64 --system-node
scripts.package:macos:no-node: npm run build && node scripts/package-local-client.mjs macos-native --system-node

author: xuzhougeng and jarxunlai
